headline: AI chip rout: Nasdaq down about 5%, chip index off ~11%, VIX up over 50%. Yields lower, oil higher.
brief: Nasdaq is down roughly 5% late in the session as the chip selloff deepened (Nvidia, Micron, AMD, Broadcom), erasing the post-midterm rally. Bonds rallied (10-yr near 4.83%) and gold firmed, a classic risk-off pattern. Tonight's Asia session opens into heavy pressure on Asian chip names after the Nikkei already fell sharply. Key risk for a bounce is short covering ahead of tomorrow's jobs report (NFP, 8:30 am New York / 1:30 pm UK).

sources.title: Yahoo Finance: Nasdaq plunges amid chip stock wipeout
Thrive in Markets: next NFP release
